verdict.rationale: The vendor's MetalRT engine targets Apple Silicon GPUs using Metal 3.1 and is benchmarked at 184 tok/s on Llama-3.2-3B, winning 3 of 4 comparisons against uzu. The GitHub repo claims acceleration on whatever silicon the device has, and the kernel pipeline validates kernels against the target silicon. However, MetalRT requires M3 or later, M1/M2 fall back to llama.cpp, and the evidence comes mostly from HN vendor comments rather than first-party docs; some users also report segfaults and install failures. Missing for 10: first-party docs on Metal/ARM optimizations, native acceleration on M1/M2, explicit ARM-level optimization details, independent hands-on benchmarks.
